propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder reads persisted REVIEW_RESULT sidecars and appends firing rows to an append-only ledger without git-object walks, enabling cheap incremental monitoring of new advisory criteria at zero marginal LLM cost.

The recorder computes detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction later de-escalated via dropped decision) over a trailing window of tickets, complementing R7's outcome-corpus metric with a within-review sidecar-only signal.

The recorder auto-includes every criterion id present in the sidecar corpus without per-criterion wiring, and is idempotent over dedup key (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id), enabling re-runnable backfill and incremental append.

The committed artifact runs/criterion_effectiveness.json is deterministic and CI-visible, computed from the existing corpus with real detection/blocking-FP metrics across 40+ criteria, proven via deterministic unit tests and zero LLM calls.
